1630    def to_hdf(
1631        self,
1632        overwrite=False,
1633        save_parameters=True,
1634        parameter_format="toml",
1635        compression=DEFAULT_HDF5_COMPRESSION,
1636        profile_dtype="f4",
1637    ):
1638        """Export the data to an HDF5.
1639
1640        Parameters
1641        ----------
1642        overwrite : bool, optional
1643            Whether to overwrite the output file. Default is False.
1644        save_parameters : bool, optional
1645            Whether to save the parameters as a separate json or toml file. Default is True.
1646        parameter_format : str, optional
1647            The format to save the parameters in. Default is 'toml'.
1648        compression : int, str or None, optional
1649            Compression for the written datasets: a gzip level 0-9,
1650            ``"lzf"``, or ``None``/``"none"``. Default is 4. ``"lzf"`` is
1651            h5py's own filter, not a standard HDF5 one -- it needs h5py (or
1652            a tool with the lzf plugin) to read the result back.
1653        profile_dtype : str, optional
1654            dtype used for the stored profile m/z and abundance arrays
1655            (``"f4"`` or ``"f8"``). Default is ``"f4"``.
1656
1657        Raises
1658        ------
1659        ValueError
1660            If parameter_format is not 'json' or 'toml'.
1661        """
1662        export_profile_spectra = (
1663            self.mass_spectra.parameters.lc_ms.export_profile_spectra
1664        )
1665
1666        # Write the mass spectra data to the hdf5 file
1667        super().to_hdf(
1668            overwrite=overwrite,
1669            export_raw=export_profile_spectra,
1670            compression=compression,
1671            profile_dtype=profile_dtype,
1672        )
1673
1674        # Write scan info, ms_unprocessed, mass features, eics, and ms2_search results to the hdf5 file
1675        with h5py.File(self.output_file.with_suffix(".hdf5"), "a") as hdf_handle:
1676            # Add scan_info to hdf5 file
1677            if "scan_info" not in hdf_handle or overwrite:
1678                if "scan_info" in hdf_handle and overwrite:
1679                    del hdf_handle["scan_info"]
1680                scan_info_group = hdf_handle.create_group("scan_info")
1681                for k, v in self.mass_spectra._scan_info.items():
1682                    array = np.array(list(v.values()))
1683                    if array.dtype.str[0:2] == "<U":
1684                        array = array.astype("S")
1685                    scan_info_group.create_dataset(
1686                        k,
1687                        data=array,
1688                        **hdf5_dataset_kwargs(array.shape, compression=compression),
1689                    )
1690
1691            # Add ms_unprocessed to hdf5 file
1692            export_unprocessed_ms1 = (
1693                self.mass_spectra.parameters.lc_ms.export_unprocessed_ms1
1694            )
1695            if self.mass_spectra._ms_unprocessed and export_unprocessed_ms1:
1696                if "ms_unprocessed" not in hdf_handle or overwrite:
1697                    if "ms_unprocessed" in hdf_handle and overwrite:
1698                        del hdf_handle["ms_unprocessed"]
1699                    ms_unprocessed_group = hdf_handle.create_group("ms_unprocessed")
1700                else:
1701                    ms_unprocessed_group = hdf_handle.get("ms_unprocessed")
1702                for k, v in self.mass_spectra._ms_unprocessed.items():
1703                    if str(k) not in ms_unprocessed_group or overwrite:
1704                        if str(k) in ms_unprocessed_group and overwrite:
1705                            del ms_unprocessed_group[str(k)]
1706                        array = np.array(v)
1707                        column_labels = (
1708                            list(v.columns)
1709                            if hasattr(v, "columns")
1710                            else ["scan", "mz", "intensity"]
1711                        )
1712                        ms_dset = ms_unprocessed_group.create_dataset(
1713                            str(k),
1714                            data=array,
1715                            **hdf5_dataset_kwargs(array.shape, compression=compression),
1716                        )
1717                        ms_dset.attrs["column_labels"] = json.dumps(column_labels)
1718
1719            # Add LCMS mass features to hdf5 file
1720            self._save_mass_features_to_hdf5(
1721                hdf_handle,
1722                group_name="mass_features",
1723                overwrite=overwrite,
1724                compression=compression,
1725            )
1726            self._save_mass_features_to_hdf5(
1727                hdf_handle,
1728                group_name="induced_mass_features",
1729                overwrite=overwrite,
1730                compression=compression,
1731            )
1732
1733            # Add EIC data to hdf5 file
1734            export_eics = self.mass_spectra.parameters.lc_ms.export_eics
1735            if len(self.mass_spectra.eics) > 0 and export_eics:
1736                if "eics" not in hdf_handle or overwrite:
1737                    if "eics" in hdf_handle and overwrite:
1738                        del hdf_handle["eics"]
1739                    eic_group = hdf_handle.create_group("eics")
1740                else:
1741                    eic_group = hdf_handle.get("eics")
1742
1743                # Use the static helper method to save the EICs
1744                self._save_eics_dict_to_hdf5(
1745                    self.mass_spectra.eics,
1746                    eic_group,
1747                    overwrite,
1748                    compression=compression,
1749                )
1750
1751            # Add ms2_search results to hdf5 file (parameterized)
1752            if len(self.mass_spectra.spectral_search_results) > 0:
1753                if "spectral_search_results" not in hdf_handle or overwrite:
1754                    if "spectral_search_results" in hdf_handle and overwrite:
1755                        del hdf_handle["spectral_search_results"]
1756                    spectral_search_results = hdf_handle.create_group(
1757                        "spectral_search_results"
1758                    )
1759                else:
1760                    spectral_search_results = hdf_handle.get("spectral_search_results")
1761                # Create group for each search result by ms2_scan / precursor_mz
1762                for k, v in self.mass_spectra.spectral_search_results.items():
1763                    # TODO KRH: Fix to handle if export_only_relevant and k not in relevant_scan_numbers: continue!
1764                    if str(k) not in spectral_search_results or overwrite:
1765                        if str(k) in spectral_search_results and overwrite:
1766                            del spectral_search_results[str(k)]
1767                        spectral_search_results.create_group(str(k))
1768                        for k2, v2 in v.items():
1769                            spectral_search_results[str(k)].create_group(str(k2))
1770                            spectral_search_results[str(k)][str(k2)].attrs[
1771                                "precursor_mz"
1772                            ] = v2.precursor_mz
1773                            spectral_search_results[str(k)][str(k2)].attrs[
1774                                "query_spectrum_id"
1775                            ] = v2.query_spectrum_id
1776                            # Loop through each of the attributes and add them as datasets (if array)
1777                            for k3, v3 in v2.__dict__.items():
1778                                if v3 is not None and k3 not in [
1779                                    "query_spectrum",
1780                                    "precursor_mz",
1781                                    "query_spectrum_id",
1782                                ]:
1783                                    if (
1784                                        k3 == "query_frag_types"
1785                                        or k3 == "ref_frag_types"
1786                                    ):
1787                                        v3 = [", ".join(x) for x in v3]
1788                                    if all(v3 is not None for v3 in v3):
1789                                        array = np.array(v3)
1790                                    if array.dtype.str[0:2] == "<U":
1791                                        array = array.astype("S")
1792                                    spectral_search_results[str(k)][
1793                                        str(k2)
1794                                    ].create_dataset(
1795                                        str(k3),
1796                                        data=array,
1797                                        **hdf5_dataset_kwargs(
1798                                            array.shape, compression=compression
1799                                        ),
1800                                    )
1801
1802            # Save parameters as separate json
1803            if save_parameters:
1804                # Check if parameter_format is valid
1805                if parameter_format not in ["json", "toml"]:
1806                    raise ValueError("parameter_format must be 'json' or 'toml'")
1807
1808                if parameter_format == "json":
1809                    dump_lcms_settings_json(
1810                        filename=self.output_file.with_suffix(".json"),
1811                        lcms_obj=self.mass_spectra,
1812                    )
1813                elif parameter_format == "toml":
1814                    dump_lcms_settings_toml(
1815                        filename=self.output_file.with_suffix(".toml"),
1816                        lcms_obj=self.mass_spectra,
1817                    )

A class to export high resolution LC-MS data.

This class provides methods to export high resolution LC-MS data to HDF5 and Parquet (tabular datasets that mirror the main HDF5 groups).

Parameters
  • out_file_path (str | Path): The output file path, do not include the file extension.
  • lcms_object (LCMSBase): The high resolution lc-ms object.
LCMSExport(out_file_path, mass_spectra)

This constructor should always be called with keyword arguments. Arguments are:

group should be None; reserved for future extension when a ThreadGroup class is implemented.

target is the callable object to be invoked by the run() method. Defaults to None, meaning nothing is called.

name is the thread name. By default, a unique name is constructed of the form "Thread-N" where N is a small decimal number.

args is a list or tuple of arguments for the target invocation. Defaults to ().

kwargs is a dictionary of keyword arguments for the target invocation. Defaults to {}.

If a subclass overrides the constructor, it must make sure to invoke the base class constructor (Thread.__init__()) before doing anything else to the thread.

1320    def to_parquet(
1321        self,
1322        overwrite=False,
1323        save_parameters=True,
1324        parameter_format="toml",
1325        export_spectra=True,
1326    ):
1327        """Export LC-MS datasets to Parquet files (tabular mirror of ``to_hdf``).
1328
1329        Writes under ``{out_file_path}.corems/``:
1330
1331        - ``scan_info.parquet``
1332        - ``mass_features.parquet``
1333        - ``induced_mass_features.parquet`` (if present)
1334        - ``mass_spectra.parquet`` (optional; all peak tables with scan metadata)
1335        - ``eics.parquet`` (if EICs are present and export is enabled)
1336        - ``spectral_search_results.parquet`` (if search results are present)
1337        - parameters as JSON or TOML when ``save_parameters`` is True
1338
1339        Parameters
1340        ----------
1341        overwrite : bool, optional
1342            Whether to overwrite existing Parquet files. Default is False.
1343        save_parameters : bool, optional
1344            Whether to save processing parameters. Default is True.
1345        parameter_format : str, optional
1346            Parameter file format, ``'json'`` or ``'toml'``. Default is ``'toml'``.
1347        export_spectra : bool, optional
1348            Whether to export loaded mass-spectrum peak tables. Default is True.
1349
1350        Notes
1351        -----
1352        Requires ``pyarrow`` (or ``fastparquet``) for pandas Parquet I/O.
1353        Raw profile arrays and nested HDF5-only blobs are not reproduced in full;
1354        use ``to_hdf`` for a complete self-contained archive.
1355        """
1356        self.dir_loc.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
1357
1358        # Scan metadata (same source as the HDF5 scan_info group)
1359        scan_df = self.mass_spectra.scan_df
1360        if scan_df is not None and not scan_df.empty:
1361            self._write_parquet(
1362                scan_df.reset_index(drop=True), "scan_info", overwrite=overwrite
1363            )
1364
1365        # Mass features
1366        if len(self.mass_spectra.mass_features) > 0:
1367            mf_df = self.mass_spectra.mass_features_to_df().reset_index(drop=False)
1368            self._write_parquet(mf_df, "mass_features", overwrite=overwrite)
1369
1370        if len(getattr(self.mass_spectra, "induced_mass_features", {}) or {}) > 0:
1371            imf_df = self.mass_spectra.mass_features_to_df(
1372                induced_features=True
1373            ).reset_index(drop=False)
1374            self._write_parquet(imf_df, "induced_mass_features", overwrite=overwrite)
1375
1376        # Peak tables for loaded spectra
1377        if export_spectra:
1378            spectra_df = self._mass_spectra_to_parquet_df()
1379            self._write_parquet(spectra_df, "mass_spectra", overwrite=overwrite)
1380
1381        # EICs
1382        export_eics = self.mass_spectra.parameters.lc_ms.export_eics
1383        if export_eics and len(self.mass_spectra.eics) > 0:
1384            eic_df = self._eics_to_parquet_df()
1385            self._write_parquet(eic_df, "eics", overwrite=overwrite)
1386
1387        # Spectral search results
1388        if len(self.mass_spectra.spectral_search_results) > 0:
1389            search_df = self._spectral_search_results_to_parquet_df()
1390            self._write_parquet(
1391                search_df, "spectral_search_results", overwrite=overwrite
1392            )
1393
1394        if save_parameters:
1395            if parameter_format not in ["json", "toml"]:
1396                raise ValueError("parameter_format must be 'json' or 'toml'")
1397            if parameter_format == "json":
1398                dump_lcms_settings_json(
1399                    filename=self.output_file.with_suffix(".json"),
1400                    lcms_obj=self.mass_spectra,
1401                )
1402            elif parameter_format == "toml":
1403                dump_lcms_settings_toml(
1404                    filename=self.output_file.with_suffix(".toml"),
1405                    lcms_obj=self.mass_spectra,
1406                )

Export LC-MS datasets to Parquet files (tabular mirror of to_hdf).

Writes under {out_file_path}.corems/:

  • scan_info.parquet
  • mass_features.parquet
  • induced_mass_features.parquet (if present)
  • mass_spectra.parquet (optional; all peak tables with scan metadata)
  • eics.parquet (if EICs are present and export is enabled)
  • spectral_search_results.parquet (if search results are present)
  • parameters as JSON or TOML when save_parameters is True
Parameters
  • overwrite (bool, optional): Whether to overwrite existing Parquet files. Default is False.
  • save_parameters (bool, optional): Whether to save processing parameters. Default is True.
  • parameter_format (str, optional): Parameter file format, 'json' or 'toml'. Default is 'toml'.
  • export_spectra (bool, optional): Whether to export loaded mass-spectrum peak tables. Default is True.
Notes

Requires pyarrow (or fastparquet) for pandas Parquet I/O. Raw profile arrays and nested HDF5-only blobs are not reproduced in full; use to_hdf for a complete self-contained archive.

def to_hdf( self, overwrite=False, save_parameters=True, parameter_format='toml', compression=4, profile_dtype='f4'):

1691            # Add ms_unprocessed to hdf5 file

1821    """A class to export LCMS metabolite data.
1822
1823    This class provides methods to export LCMS metabolite data to various formats

1825

1833
1834    def __init__(self, out_file_path, mass_spectra):

1837
1838    @staticmethod
1839    def get_ion_formula(neutral_formula, ion_type):
1840        """From a neutral formula and an ion type, return the formula of the ion.
1841
1842        Notes
1843        -----
1844        Delegates to
1845        :meth:`corems.molecular_formula.calc.MolecularFormulaCalc.MolecularFormulaCalc.get_ion_formula`.
1846
1847        Parameters
1848        ----------
1849        neutral_formula : str
1850            The neutral formula, this should be a string form from the MolecularFormula class
1851            (e.g. 'C2 H4 O2', isotopes OK), or simple string (e.g. 'C2H4O2', no isotope handling in this case).
1852            In the case of a simple string, the atoms are parsed based on the presence of capital letters,
1853            e.g. MgCl2 is parsed as 'Mg Cl2.
1854        ion_type : str
1855            The ion type, e.g. 'protonated', '[M+H]+', '[M+Na]+', etc.
1856            See ``MolecularFormulaCalc.ion_type_dict`` for the available ion types.
1857
1858        Returns
1859        -------
1860        str
1861            The formula of the ion as a string (like 'C2 H4 O2'); or None if the neutral_formula is not a string.
1862        """
1863        return MolecularFormulaCalc.get_ion_formula(neutral_formula, ion_type)
1864
1865    @staticmethod
1866    def precursor_mz_from_formula(neutral_formula, ion_type, charge=None):
1867        """Calculated precursor m/z from neutral formula and adduct / ion type.
1868
1869        Notes
1870        -----
1871        Delegates to
1872        :meth:`corems.molecular_formula.calc.MolecularFormulaCalc.MolecularFormulaCalc.precursor_mz_from_formula`.
1873        """
1874        return MolecularFormulaCalc.precursor_mz_from_formula(
1875            neutral_formula, ion_type, charge=charge
1876        )
1877
1878    @staticmethod
1879    def get_isotope_type(ion_formula):
1880        """From an ion formula, return the 13C isotope type of the ion.
1881
1882        Notes
1883        -----
1884        This is a static method.
1885        If the ion_formula is not a string, this method will return None.
1886        This is currently only functional for 13C isotopes.
1887
1888        Parameters
1889        ----------
1890        ion_formula : str
1891            The formula of the ion, expected to be a string like 'C2 H4 O2'.
1892
1893        Returns
1894        -------
1895        str
1896            The isotope type of the ion, e.g. '13C1', '13C2', etc; or None if the ion_formula does not contain a 13C isotope.
1897
1898        Raises
1899        ------
1900        ValueError
1901            If the ion_formula is not a string.
1902        """
1903        if not isinstance(ion_formula, str):
1904            return None
1905
1906        if re.search(r"\s", ion_formula):
1907            ion_formula = MolecularFormula(ion_formula, ion_charge=0)
1908        else:
1909            raise ValueError('ion_formula should be a string like "C2 H4 O2"')
1910        ion_formula_dict = ion_formula.to_dict().copy()
1911
1912        try:
1913            iso_class = "13C" + str(ion_formula_dict.pop("13C"))
1914        except KeyError:
1915            iso_class = None
1916
1917        return iso_class

1948    def clean_ms1_report(self, ms1_summary_full):
1949        """Clean the MS1 report.

1953        ms1_summary_full : DataFrame

1955
1956        Returns
1957        -------
1958        DataFrame
1959            The cleaned MS1 summary DataFrame.
1960        """
1961        ms1_summary_full = ms1_summary_full.reset_index()
1962        cols_to_keep = [
1963            "mf_id",
1964            "Molecular Formula",
1965            "Ion Type",
1966            "Calculated m/z",
1967            "m/z Error (ppm)",
1968            "m/z Error Score",
1969            "Is Isotopologue",
1970            "Isotopologue Similarity",
1971            "Confidence Score",
1972        ]
1973        ms1_summary = ms1_summary_full[cols_to_keep].copy()
1974        ms1_summary["ion_formula"] = [
1975            self.get_ion_formula(f, a)
1976            for f, a in zip(ms1_summary["Molecular Formula"], ms1_summary["Ion Type"])
1977        ]
1978        ms1_summary["isotopologue_type"] = [
1979            self.get_isotope_type(f) for f in ms1_summary["ion_formula"].tolist()
1980        ]
1981
1982        # Keep MS1 neutral Molecular Formula so it is not confused with library formulas
1983        # from MS2 spectral metadata.
1984        ms1_summary = ms1_summary[
1985            [
1986                "mf_id",
1987                "ion_formula",
1988                "isotopologue_type",
1989                "Molecular Formula",
1990                "Calculated m/z",
1991                "m/z Error (ppm)",
1992                "m/z Error Score",
1993                "Isotopologue Similarity",
1994                "Confidence Score",
1995            ]
1996        ]
1997
1998        # Set the index to mf_id
1999        ms1_summary = ms1_summary.set_index("mf_id")
2000
2001        return ms1_summary

2003    def summarize_ms2_report(self, ms2_annot_report):
2004        """
2005        Summarize the MS2 report.
2006
2007        Parameters
2008        ----------

2010            The MS2 annotation DataFrame with all annotations, output of mass_features_ms2_annot_to_df.
2011

2013        -------
2014        """

2016    def summarize_metabolomics_report(self, ms2_annot_report):
2017        """Summarize the MS2 hits for a metabolomics report
2018
2019        Parameters
2020        ----------
2021        ms2_annot : DataFrame
2022            The MS2 annotation DataFrame with all annotations.
2023
2024        Returns
2025        -------
2026        DataFrame
2027            The summarized metabolomics report.
2028        """
2029        columns_to_drop = [
2030            "precursor_mz",
2031            "precursor_mz_error_ppm",
2032            "cas",
2033            "data_id",
2034            "iupac_name",
2035            "traditional_name",
2036            "common_name",
2037            "casno",
2038        ]
2039        ms2_annot = ms2_annot_report.drop(
2040            columns=[col for col in columns_to_drop if col in ms2_annot_report.columns]
2041        )
2042
2043        # Prepare information about the search results, pulling out the best hit for the single report
2044        # Group by mf_id,ref_mol_id grab row with highest entropy similarity
2045        ms2_annot = ms2_annot.reset_index()
2046        # Add column called "n_spectra_contributing" that is the number of unique values in query_spectrum_id per mf_id,ref_mol_id
2047        ms2_annot["n_spectra_contributing"] = ms2_annot.groupby(
2048            ["mf_id", "ref_mol_id"]
2049        )["query_spectrum_id"].transform("nunique")
2050        # Sort by entropy similarity
2051        ms2_annot = ms2_annot.sort_values(
2052            by=["mf_id", "ref_mol_id", "entropy_similarity"],
2053            ascending=[True, True, False],
2054        )
2055        best_entropy = ms2_annot.drop_duplicates(
2056            subset=["mf_id", "ref_mol_id"], keep="first"
2057        )
2058
2059        return best_entropy

2075        # Library (MS2 metadata) formulas — keep separate from MS1 search fields
2076        metabolite_summary["library_ion_formula"] = [
2077            self.get_ion_formula(f, a)
2078            for f, a in zip(
2079                metabolite_summary["formula"], metabolite_summary["ref_ion_type"]
2080            )
2081        ]
2082        metabolite_summary = metabolite_summary.rename(

2084        )
2085
2086        col_order = [
2087            "mf_id",
2088            "library_ion_formula",
2089            "ref_ion_type",
2090            "library_formula",
2091            "inchikey",
2092            "name",
2093            "inchi",
2094            "chebi",
2095            "smiles",

2097            "cas",
2098            "database_name",
2099            "ref_ms_id",
2100            "entropy_similarity",

2102            "n_spectra_contributing",
2103        ]
2104
2105        # Reorder columns
2106        metabolite_summary = metabolite_summary[
2107            [col for col in col_order if col in metabolite_summary.columns]
2108        ]
2109
2110        # Convert chebi (if present) to int:
2111        if "chebi" in metabolite_summary.columns:

2121    def combine_reports(self, mf_report, ms1_annot_report, ms2_annot_report):
2122        """Combine the mass feature report with the MS1 and MS2 reports.
2123
2124        Parameters
2125        ----------
2126        mf_report : DataFrame
2127            The mass feature report DataFrame.
2128        ms1_annot_report : DataFrame
2129            The MS1 annotation report DataFrame.
2130        ms2_annot_report : DataFrame
2131            The MS2 annotation report DataFrame.
2132
2133        Notes
2134        -----
2135        ``Molecular Formula`` / ``Ion Formula`` come only from MS1 molecular
2136        formula search. MS2 spectral library formulas are exposed as
2137        ``Library Molecular Formula`` / ``Library Ion Formula``.
2138        When MS1 and MS2 match (same ion formula), the library formula columns
2139        are cleared so they do not repeat the MS1 values on that row.
2140        """
2141        # If there is an ms1_annot_report, merge it with the mf_report
2142        if ms1_annot_report is not None and not ms1_annot_report.empty:
2143            # MS1 has been run and has molecular formula information
2144            mf_report = pd.merge(
2145                mf_report,
2146                ms1_annot_report,
2147                how="left",
2148                on=["mf_id", "isotopologue_type"],
2149            )
2150        if ms2_annot_report is not None:
2151            # Prefer joining MS2 hits to matching MS1 ion formula when both exist.
2152            # MS2 uses library_ion_formula so MS1 Ion Formula is not overwritten.
2153            if (
2154                "ion_formula" in mf_report.columns
2155                and "library_ion_formula" in ms2_annot_report.columns
2156            ):
2157                # pull out the records without ion_formula and merge on mf_id only
2158                mf_no_ion_formula = mf_report[mf_report["ion_formula"].isna()]
2159                mf_no_ion_formula = (
2160                    mf_no_ion_formula.drop(columns=["ion_formula"])
2161                    if "ion_formula" in mf_no_ion_formula.columns
2162                    else mf_no_ion_formula
2163                )
2164                mf_no_ion_formula = pd.merge(
2165                    mf_no_ion_formula, ms2_annot_report, how="left", on=["mf_id"]
2166                )
2167
2168                # pull out the records with ion_formula and merge on mf_id + formula match
2169                mf_with_ion_formula = mf_report[~mf_report["ion_formula"].isna()]
2170                mf_with_ion_formula = pd.merge(
2171                    mf_with_ion_formula,
2172                    ms2_annot_report,
2173                    how="left",
2174                    left_on=["mf_id", "ion_formula"],
2175                    right_on=["mf_id", "library_ion_formula"],
2176                )
2177
2178                # put back together
2179                mf_report = pd.concat([mf_no_ion_formula, mf_with_ion_formula])
2180            else:
2181                # Fall back to merging on mf_id only (robust when ion_formula missing)
2182                mf_report = pd.merge(
2183                    mf_report, ms2_annot_report, how="left", on=["mf_id"]
2184                )
2185
2186        # Rename colums
2187        rename_dict = {
2188            "mf_id": "Mass Feature ID",
2189            "scan_time": "Retention Time (min)",
2190            "mz": "m/z",
2191            "apex_scan": "Apex Scan Number",
2192            "intensity": "Intensity",
2193            "persistence": "Persistence",
2194            "area": "Area",
2195            "half_height_width": "Half Height Width (min)",
2196            "tailing_factor": "Tailing Factor",
2197            "dispersity_index": "Dispersity Index",
2198            "ms2_spectrum": "MS2 Spectrum",
2199            "monoisotopic_mf_id": "Monoisotopic Mass Feature ID",
2200            "isotopologue_type": "Isotopologue Type",
2201            "mass_spectrum_deconvoluted_parent": "Is Largest Ion after Deconvolution",
2202            "associated_mass_features": "Associated Mass Features after Deconvolution",
2203            "ion_formula": "Ion Formula",
2204            "library_ion_formula": "Library Ion Formula",
2205            "library_formula": "Library Molecular Formula",
2206            "ref_ion_type": "Library Ion Type",
2207            "annot_level": "Lipid Annotation Level",
2208            "lipid_molecular_species_id": "Lipid Molecular Species",
2209            "lipid_summed_name": "Lipid Species",
2210            "lipid_subclass": "Lipid Subclass",
2211            "lipid_class": "Lipid Class",
2212            "lipid_category": "Lipid Category",
2213            "entropy_similarity": "Entropy Similarity",
2214            "ref_mz_in_query_fract": "Library mzs in Query (fraction)",
2215            "n_spectra_contributing": "Spectra with Annotation (n)",
2216        }
2217        mf_report = mf_report.rename(columns=rename_dict)
2218
2219        # When MS1 and MS2 co-annotate the same ion/molecular formula, library formula
2220        # columns only repeat MS1 fields — clear them so the row is not redundant.
2221        # Keep Library * columns populated for MS2-only (or mismatched) hits.
2222        if (
2223            "Ion Formula" in mf_report.columns
2224            and "Library Ion Formula" in mf_report.columns
2225        ):
2226            ion_match = (
2227                mf_report["Ion Formula"].notna()
2228                & mf_report["Library Ion Formula"].notna()
2229                & (mf_report["Ion Formula"] == mf_report["Library Ion Formula"])
2230            )
2231            mf_report.loc[ion_match, "Library Ion Formula"] = pd.NA
2232            if "Library Molecular Formula" in mf_report.columns:
2233                mf_report.loc[ion_match, "Library Molecular Formula"] = pd.NA
2234        elif (
2235            "Molecular Formula" in mf_report.columns
2236            and "Library Molecular Formula" in mf_report.columns
2237        ):
2238            mol_match = (
2239                mf_report["Molecular Formula"].notna()
2240                & mf_report["Library Molecular Formula"].notna()
2241                & (
2242                    mf_report["Molecular Formula"]
2243                    == mf_report["Library Molecular Formula"]
2244                )
2245            )
2246            mf_report.loc[mol_match, "Library Molecular Formula"] = pd.NA
2247            if "Library Ion Formula" in mf_report.columns:
2248                mf_report.loc[mol_match, "Library Ion Formula"] = pd.NA
2249
2250        mf_report["Sample Name"] = self.mass_spectra.sample_name
2251        mf_report["Polarity"] = self.mass_spectra.polarity
2252        mf_report = mf_report[
2253            ["Mass Feature ID", "Sample Name", "Polarity"]
2254            + [
2255                col
2256                for col in mf_report.columns
2257                if col not in ["Mass Feature ID", "Sample Name", "Polarity"]
2258            ]
2259        ]
2260
2261        # Reorder rows by "Mass Feature ID", then "Entropy Similarity" (descending), then "Confidence Score" (descending)
2262        if (
2263            "Entropy Similarity" in mf_report.columns
2264            and "Confidence Score" in mf_report.columns
2265        ):
2266            mf_report = mf_report.sort_values(
2267                by=["Mass Feature ID", "Entropy Similarity", "Confidence Score"],
2268                ascending=[True, False, False],
2269            )
2270        elif "Entropy Similarity" in mf_report.columns:
2271            mf_report = mf_report.sort_values(
2272                by=["Mass Feature ID", "Entropy Similarity"],
2273                ascending=[True, False],
2274            )
2275        elif "Confidence Score" in mf_report.columns:
2276            mf_report = mf_report.sort_values(
2277                by=["Mass Feature ID", "Confidence Score"],
2278                ascending=[True, False],
2279            )
2280        # If neither "Entropy Similarity" nor "Confidence Score" are in the columns, just sort by "Mass Feature ID"
2281        else:
2282            mf_report = mf_report.sort_values("Mass Feature ID")
2283
2284        # Reset index
2285        mf_report = mf_report.reset_index(drop=True)
2286
2287        return mf_report

2289    def to_report(self, molecular_metadata=None, suppress_warnings=False):
2290        """Create a report of the mass features and their annotations.
2291
2292        Parameters
2293        ----------
2294        molecular_metadata : dict, optional
2295            The molecular metadata. Default is None.
2296        suppress_warnings : bool, optional
2297            If True, suppresses warnings from mass_features_ms2_annot_to_df.
2298            Default is False.
2299
2300        Returns
2301        -------
2302        DataFrame
2303            The report as a Pandas DataFrame.
2304        """
2305        # Get mass feature dataframe
2306        mf_report = self.mass_spectra.mass_features_to_df()
2307        mf_report = mf_report.reset_index(drop=False)
2308
2309        # Get and clean ms1 annotation dataframe
2310        ms1_annot_report = self.mass_spectra.mass_features_ms1_annot_to_df(
2311            suppress_warnings=suppress_warnings
2312        )
2313        if ms1_annot_report is not None:
2314            ms1_annot_report = ms1_annot_report.copy()
2315            ms1_annot_report = self.clean_ms1_report(ms1_annot_report)
2316            ms1_annot_report = ms1_annot_report.reset_index(drop=False)
2317        else:
2318            ms1_annot_report = None
2319
2320        # Get, summarize, and clean ms2 annotation dataframe
2321        ms2_annot_report = self.mass_spectra.mass_features_ms2_annot_to_df(
2322            molecular_metadata=molecular_metadata, suppress_warnings=suppress_warnings
2323        )
2324        if ms2_annot_report is not None and molecular_metadata is not None:
2325            ms2_annot_report = self.summarize_metabolomics_report(ms2_annot_report)
2326            ms2_annot_report = self.clean_ms2_report(ms2_annot_report)
2327            ms2_annot_report = ms2_annot_report.dropna(axis=1, how="all")
2328            ms2_annot_report = ms2_annot_report.reset_index(drop=False)
2329        else:
2330            ms2_annot_report = None
2331
2332        report = self.combine_reports(
2333            mf_report=mf_report,
2334            ms1_annot_report=ms1_annot_report,
2335            ms2_annot_report=ms2_annot_report,
2336        )
2337
2338        return report

This constructor should always be called with keyword arguments. Arguments are:

group should be None; reserved for future extension when a ThreadGroup class is implemented.

target is the callable object to be invoked by the run() method. Defaults to None, meaning nothing is called.

name is the thread name. By default, a unique name is constructed of the form "Thread-N" where N is a small decimal number.

args is a list or tuple of arguments for the target invocation. Defaults to ().

kwargs is a dictionary of keyword arguments for the target invocation. Defaults to {}.

If a subclass overrides the constructor, it must make sure to invoke the base class constructor (Thread.__init__()) before doing anything else to the thread.

@staticmethod
def get_isotope_type(ion_formula): 
1878    @staticmethod
1879    def get_isotope_type(ion_formula):
1880        """From an ion formula, return the 13C isotope type of the ion.
1881
1882        Notes
1883        -----
1884        This is a static method.
1885        If the ion_formula is not a string, this method will return None.
1886        This is currently only functional for 13C isotopes.
1887
1888        Parameters
1889        ----------
1890        ion_formula : str
1891            The formula of the ion, expected to be a string like 'C2 H4 O2'.
1892
1893        Returns
1894        -------
1895        str
1896            The isotope type of the ion, e.g. '13C1', '13C2', etc; or None if the ion_formula does not contain a 13C isotope.
1897
1898        Raises
1899        ------
1900        ValueError
1901            If the ion_formula is not a string.
1902        """
1903        if not isinstance(ion_formula, str):
1904            return None
1905
1906        if re.search(r"\s", ion_formula):
1907            ion_formula = MolecularFormula(ion_formula, ion_charge=0)
1908        else:
1909            raise ValueError('ion_formula should be a string like "C2 H4 O2"')
1910        ion_formula_dict = ion_formula.to_dict().copy()
1911
1912        try:
1913            iso_class = "13C" + str(ion_formula_dict.pop("13C"))
1914        except KeyError:
1915            iso_class = None
1916
1917        return iso_class

1948    def clean_ms1_report(self, ms1_summary_full):
1949        """Clean the MS1 report.
1950
1951        Parameters
1952        ----------
1953        ms1_summary_full : DataFrame
1954            The full MS1 summary DataFrame.
1955
1956        Returns
1957        -------
1958        DataFrame
1959            The cleaned MS1 summary DataFrame.
1960        """
1961        ms1_summary_full = ms1_summary_full.reset_index()
1962        cols_to_keep = [
1963            "mf_id",
1964            "Molecular Formula",
1965            "Ion Type",
1966            "Calculated m/z",
1967            "m/z Error (ppm)",
1968            "m/z Error Score",
1969            "Is Isotopologue",
1970            "Isotopologue Similarity",
1971            "Confidence Score",
1972        ]
1973        ms1_summary = ms1_summary_full[cols_to_keep].copy()
1974        ms1_summary["ion_formula"] = [
1975            self.get_ion_formula(f, a)
1976            for f, a in zip(ms1_summary["Molecular Formula"], ms1_summary["Ion Type"])
1977        ]
1978        ms1_summary["isotopologue_type"] = [
1979            self.get_isotope_type(f) for f in ms1_summary["ion_formula"].tolist()
1980        ]
1981
1982        # Keep MS1 neutral Molecular Formula so it is not confused with library formulas
1983        # from MS2 spectral metadata.
1984        ms1_summary = ms1_summary[
1985            [
1986                "mf_id",
1987                "ion_formula",
1988                "isotopologue_type",
1989                "Molecular Formula",
1990                "Calculated m/z",
1991                "m/z Error (ppm)",
1992                "m/z Error Score",
1993                "Isotopologue Similarity",
1994                "Confidence Score",
1995            ]
1996        ]
1997
1998        # Set the index to mf_id
1999        ms1_summary = ms1_summary.set_index("mf_id")
2000
2001        return ms1_summary

def summarize_metabolomics_report(self, ms2_annot_report): 
2016    def summarize_metabolomics_report(self, ms2_annot_report):
2017        """Summarize the MS2 hits for a metabolomics report
2018
2019        Parameters
2020        ----------
2021        ms2_annot : DataFrame
2022            The MS2 annotation DataFrame with all annotations.
2023
2024        Returns
2025        -------
2026        DataFrame
2027            The summarized metabolomics report.
2028        """
2029        columns_to_drop = [
2030            "precursor_mz",
2031            "precursor_mz_error_ppm",
2032            "cas",
2033            "data_id",
2034            "iupac_name",
2035            "traditional_name",
2036            "common_name",
2037            "casno",
2038        ]
2039        ms2_annot = ms2_annot_report.drop(
2040            columns=[col for col in columns_to_drop if col in ms2_annot_report.columns]
2041        )
2042
2043        # Prepare information about the search results, pulling out the best hit for the single report
2044        # Group by mf_id,ref_mol_id grab row with highest entropy similarity
2045        ms2_annot = ms2_annot.reset_index()
2046        # Add column called "n_spectra_contributing" that is the number of unique values in query_spectrum_id per mf_id,ref_mol_id
2047        ms2_annot["n_spectra_contributing"] = ms2_annot.groupby(
2048            ["mf_id", "ref_mol_id"]
2049        )["query_spectrum_id"].transform("nunique")
2050        # Sort by entropy similarity
2051        ms2_annot = ms2_annot.sort_values(
2052            by=["mf_id", "ref_mol_id", "entropy_similarity"],
2053            ascending=[True, True, False],
2054        )
2055        best_entropy = ms2_annot.drop_duplicates(
2056            subset=["mf_id", "ref_mol_id"], keep="first"
2057        )
2058
2059        return best_entropy

def combine_reports(self, mf_report, ms1_annot_report, ms2_annot_report): 
2121    def combine_reports(self, mf_report, ms1_annot_report, ms2_annot_report):
2122        """Combine the mass feature report with the MS1 and MS2 reports.
2123
2124        Parameters
2125        ----------
2126        mf_report : DataFrame
2127            The mass feature report DataFrame.
2128        ms1_annot_report : DataFrame
2129            The MS1 annotation report DataFrame.
2130        ms2_annot_report : DataFrame
2131            The MS2 annotation report DataFrame.
2132
2133        Notes
2134        -----
2135        ``Molecular Formula`` / ``Ion Formula`` come only from MS1 molecular
2136        formula search. MS2 spectral library formulas are exposed as
2137        ``Library Molecular Formula`` / ``Library Ion Formula``.
2138        When MS1 and MS2 match (same ion formula), the library formula columns
2139        are cleared so they do not repeat the MS1 values on that row.
2140        """
2141        # If there is an ms1_annot_report, merge it with the mf_report
2142        if ms1_annot_report is not None and not ms1_annot_report.empty:
2143            # MS1 has been run and has molecular formula information
2144            mf_report = pd.merge(
2145                mf_report,
2146                ms1_annot_report,
2147                how="left",
2148                on=["mf_id", "isotopologue_type"],
2149            )
2150        if ms2_annot_report is not None:
2151            # Prefer joining MS2 hits to matching MS1 ion formula when both exist.
2152            # MS2 uses library_ion_formula so MS1 Ion Formula is not overwritten.
2153            if (
2154                "ion_formula" in mf_report.columns
2155                and "library_ion_formula" in ms2_annot_report.columns
2156            ):
2157                # pull out the records without ion_formula and merge on mf_id only
2158                mf_no_ion_formula = mf_report[mf_report["ion_formula"].isna()]
2159                mf_no_ion_formula = (
2160                    mf_no_ion_formula.drop(columns=["ion_formula"])
2161                    if "ion_formula" in mf_no_ion_formula.columns
2162                    else mf_no_ion_formula
2163                )
2164                mf_no_ion_formula = pd.merge(
2165                    mf_no_ion_formula, ms2_annot_report, how="left", on=["mf_id"]
2166                )
2167
2168                # pull out the records with ion_formula and merge on mf_id + formula match
2169                mf_with_ion_formula = mf_report[~mf_report["ion_formula"].isna()]
2170                mf_with_ion_formula = pd.merge(
2171                    mf_with_ion_formula,
2172                    ms2_annot_report,
2173                    how="left",
2174                    left_on=["mf_id", "ion_formula"],
2175                    right_on=["mf_id", "library_ion_formula"],
2176                )
2177
2178                # put back together
2179                mf_report = pd.concat([mf_no_ion_formula, mf_with_ion_formula])
2180            else:
2181                # Fall back to merging on mf_id only (robust when ion_formula missing)
2182                mf_report = pd.merge(
2183                    mf_report, ms2_annot_report, how="left", on=["mf_id"]
2184                )
2185
2186        # Rename colums
2187        rename_dict = {
2188            "mf_id": "Mass Feature ID",
2189            "scan_time": "Retention Time (min)",
2190            "mz": "m/z",
2191            "apex_scan": "Apex Scan Number",
2192            "intensity": "Intensity",
2193            "persistence": "Persistence",
2194            "area": "Area",
2195            "half_height_width": "Half Height Width (min)",
2196            "tailing_factor": "Tailing Factor",
2197            "dispersity_index": "Dispersity Index",
2198            "ms2_spectrum": "MS2 Spectrum",
2199            "monoisotopic_mf_id": "Monoisotopic Mass Feature ID",
2200            "isotopologue_type": "Isotopologue Type",
2201            "mass_spectrum_deconvoluted_parent": "Is Largest Ion after Deconvolution",
2202            "associated_mass_features": "Associated Mass Features after Deconvolution",
2203            "ion_formula": "Ion Formula",
2204            "library_ion_formula": "Library Ion Formula",
2205            "library_formula": "Library Molecular Formula",
2206            "ref_ion_type": "Library Ion Type",
2207            "annot_level": "Lipid Annotation Level",
2208            "lipid_molecular_species_id": "Lipid Molecular Species",
2209            "lipid_summed_name": "Lipid Species",
2210            "lipid_subclass": "Lipid Subclass",
2211            "lipid_class": "Lipid Class",
2212            "lipid_category": "Lipid Category",
2213            "entropy_similarity": "Entropy Similarity",
2214            "ref_mz_in_query_fract": "Library mzs in Query (fraction)",
2215            "n_spectra_contributing": "Spectra with Annotation (n)",
2216        }
2217        mf_report = mf_report.rename(columns=rename_dict)
2218
2219        # When MS1 and MS2 co-annotate the same ion/molecular formula, library formula
2220        # columns only repeat MS1 fields — clear them so the row is not redundant.
2221        # Keep Library * columns populated for MS2-only (or mismatched) hits.
2222        if (
2223            "Ion Formula" in mf_report.columns
2224            and "Library Ion Formula" in mf_report.columns
2225        ):
2226            ion_match = (
2227                mf_report["Ion Formula"].notna()
2228                & mf_report["Library Ion Formula"].notna()
2229                & (mf_report["Ion Formula"] == mf_report["Library Ion Formula"])
2230            )
2231            mf_report.loc[ion_match, "Library Ion Formula"] = pd.NA
2232            if "Library Molecular Formula" in mf_report.columns:
2233                mf_report.loc[ion_match, "Library Molecular Formula"] = pd.NA
2234        elif (
2235            "Molecular Formula" in mf_report.columns
2236            and "Library Molecular Formula" in mf_report.columns
2237        ):
2238            mol_match = (
2239                mf_report["Molecular Formula"].notna()
2240                & mf_report["Library Molecular Formula"].notna()
2241                & (
2242                    mf_report["Molecular Formula"]
2243                    == mf_report["Library Molecular Formula"]
2244                )
2245            )
2246            mf_report.loc[mol_match, "Library Molecular Formula"] = pd.NA
2247            if "Library Ion Formula" in mf_report.columns:
2248                mf_report.loc[mol_match, "Library Ion Formula"] = pd.NA
2249
2250        mf_report["Sample Name"] = self.mass_spectra.sample_name
2251        mf_report["Polarity"] = self.mass_spectra.polarity
2252        mf_report = mf_report[
2253            ["Mass Feature ID", "Sample Name", "Polarity"]
2254            + [
2255                col
2256                for col in mf_report.columns
2257                if col not in ["Mass Feature ID", "Sample Name", "Polarity"]
2258            ]
2259        ]
2260
2261        # Reorder rows by "Mass Feature ID", then "Entropy Similarity" (descending), then "Confidence Score" (descending)
2262        if (
2263            "Entropy Similarity" in mf_report.columns
2264            and "Confidence Score" in mf_report.columns
2265        ):
2266            mf_report = mf_report.sort_values(
2267                by=["Mass Feature ID", "Entropy Similarity", "Confidence Score"],
2268                ascending=[True, False, False],
2269            )
2270        elif "Entropy Similarity" in mf_report.columns:
2271            mf_report = mf_report.sort_values(
2272                by=["Mass Feature ID", "Entropy Similarity"],
2273                ascending=[True, False],
2274            )
2275        elif "Confidence Score" in mf_report.columns:
2276            mf_report = mf_report.sort_values(
2277                by=["Mass Feature ID", "Confidence Score"],
2278                ascending=[True, False],
2279            )
2280        # If neither "Entropy Similarity" nor "Confidence Score" are in the columns, just sort by "Mass Feature ID"
2281        else:
2282            mf_report = mf_report.sort_values("Mass Feature ID")
2283
2284        # Reset index
2285        mf_report = mf_report.reset_index(drop=True)
2286
2287        return mf_report

2359        """Summarize the lipid report.
2360
2361        Parameters
2362        ----------
2363        ms2_annot : DataFrame
2364            The MS2 annotation DataFrame with all annotations.
2365
2366        Returns
2367        -------
2368        DataFrame
2369            The summarized lipid report.
2370        """
2371        # Drop unnecessary columns for easier viewing
2372        columns_to_drop = [
2373            "precursor_mz",
2374            "precursor_mz_error_ppm",
2375            "ref_mol_id",
2376            "ref_precursor_mz",
2377            "cas",
2378            "inchikey",
2379            "inchi",
2380            "chebi",
2381            "smiles",
2382            "kegg",
2383            "data_id",
2384            "iupac_name",
2385            "traditional_name",
2386            "common_name",
2387            "casno",
2388        ]
2389        ms2_annot = ms2_annot.drop(
2390            columns=[col for col in columns_to_drop if col in ms2_annot.columns]
2391        )
2392
2393        # If ion_types_excluded is not empty, remove those ion types
2394        ion_types_excluded = self.mass_spectra.parameters.mass_spectrum[
2395            "ms2"
2396        ].molecular_search.ion_types_excluded
2397        if len(ion_types_excluded) > 0:
2398            ms2_annot = ms2_annot[~ms2_annot["ref_ion_type"].isin(ion_types_excluded)]
2399
2400        # If mf_id is not present, check that the index name is mf_id and reset the index
2401        if "mf_id" not in ms2_annot.columns:
2402            if ms2_annot.index.name == "mf_id":
2403                ms2_annot = ms2_annot.reset_index()
2404            else:
2405                raise ValueError("mf_id is not present in the dataframe")
2406
2407        # Attempt to get consensus annotations to the MLF level
2408        mlf_results_all = []
2409        for mf_id in ms2_annot["mf_id"].unique():
2410            mlf_results_perid = []
2411            ms2_annot_mf = ms2_annot[ms2_annot["mf_id"] == mf_id].copy()
2412            ms2_annot_mf["n_spectra_contributing"] = (
2413                ms2_annot_mf.query_spectrum_id.nunique()
2414            )
2415
2416            for query_scan in ms2_annot["query_spectrum_id"].unique():
2417                ms2_annot_sub = ms2_annot_mf[
2418                    ms2_annot_mf["query_spectrum_id"] == query_scan
2419                ].copy()
2420
2421                if ms2_annot_sub["lipid_summed_name"].nunique() == 1:
2422                    # If there is only one lipid_summed_name, let's try to get consensus molecular species annotation
2423                    if ms2_annot_sub["lipid_summed_name"].nunique() == 1:
2424                        ms2_annot_sub["entropy_max"] = (
2425                            ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"]
2426                            == ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"].max()
2427                        )
2428                        ms2_annot_sub["ref_match_fract_max"] = (
2429                            ms2_annot_sub["ref_mz_in_query_fract"]
2430                            == ms2_annot_sub["ref_mz_in_query_fract"].max()
2431                        )
2432                        ms2_annot_sub["frag_max"] = ms2_annot_sub[
2433                            "query_frag_types"
2434                        ].apply(lambda x: True if "MLF" in x else False)
2435
2436                        # New column that looks if there is a consensus between the ranks (one row that is highest in all ranks)
2437                        ms2_annot_sub["consensus"] = ms2_annot_sub[
2438                            ["entropy_max", "ref_match_fract_max", "frag_max"]
2439                        ].all(axis=1)
2440
2441                        # If there is a consensus, take the row with the highest entropy_similarity
2442                        if ms2_annot_sub["consensus"].any():
2443                            ms2_annot_sub = ms2_annot_sub[
2444                                ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"]
2445                                == ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"].max()
2446                            ].head(1)
2447                            mlf_results_perid.append(ms2_annot_sub)
2448            if len(mlf_results_perid) == 0:
2449                mlf_results_perid = pd.DataFrame()
2450            else:
2451                mlf_results_perid = pd.concat(mlf_results_perid)
2452                if mlf_results_perid["name"].nunique() == 1:
2453                    mlf_results_perid = mlf_results_perid[
2454                        mlf_results_perid["entropy_similarity"]
2455                        == mlf_results_perid["entropy_similarity"].max()
2456                    ].head(1)
2457                else:
2458                    mlf_results_perid = pd.DataFrame()
2459                mlf_results_all.append(mlf_results_perid)
2460
2461        # These are the consensus annotations to the MLF level
2462        if len(mlf_results_all) > 0:
2463            mlf_results_all = pd.concat(mlf_results_all)
2464            mlf_results_all["annot_level"] = mlf_results_all["structure_level"]
2465        else:
2466            # Make an empty dataframe
2467            mlf_results_all = ms2_annot.head(0)
2468
2469        # For remaining mf_ids, try to get a consensus annotation to the species level
2470        species_results_all = []
2471        # Remove mf_ids that have consensus annotations to the MLF level
2472        ms2_annot_spec = ms2_annot[
2473            ~ms2_annot["mf_id"].isin(mlf_results_all["mf_id"].unique())
2474        ]
2475        for mf_id in ms2_annot_spec["mf_id"].unique():
2476            # Do all the hits have the same lipid_summed_name?
2477            ms2_annot_sub = ms2_annot_spec[ms2_annot_spec["mf_id"] == mf_id].copy()
2478            ms2_annot_sub["n_spectra_contributing"] = len(ms2_annot_sub)
2479
2480            if ms2_annot_sub["lipid_summed_name"].nunique() == 1:
2481                # Grab the highest entropy_similarity result
2482                ms2_annot_sub = ms2_annot_sub[
2483                    ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"]
2484                    == ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"].max()
2485                ].head(1)
2486                species_results_all.append(ms2_annot_sub)
2487
2488        # These are the consensus annotations to the species level
2489        if len(species_results_all) > 0:
2490            species_results_all = pd.concat(species_results_all)
2491            species_results_all["annot_level"] = "species"
2492        else:
2493            # Make an empty dataframe
2494            species_results_all = ms2_annot.head(0)
2495
2496        # Deal with the remaining mf_ids that do not have consensus annotations to the species level or MLF level
2497        # Remove mf_ids that have consensus annotations to the species level
2498        ms2_annot_remaining = ms2_annot_spec[
2499            ~ms2_annot_spec["mf_id"].isin(species_results_all["mf_id"].unique())
2500        ]
2501        no_consensus = []
2502        for mf_id in ms2_annot_remaining["mf_id"].unique():
2503            id_sub = []
2504            id_no_con = []
2505            ms2_annot_sub_mf = ms2_annot_remaining[
2506                ms2_annot_remaining["mf_id"] == mf_id
2507            ].copy()
2508            for query_scan in ms2_annot_sub_mf["query_spectrum_id"].unique():
2509                ms2_annot_sub = ms2_annot_sub_mf[
2510                    ms2_annot_sub_mf["query_spectrum_id"] == query_scan
2511                ].copy()
2512
2513                # New columns for ranking [HIGHER RANK = BETTER]
2514                ms2_annot_sub["entropy_max"] = (
2515                    ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"]
2516                    == ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"].max()
2517                )
2518                ms2_annot_sub["ref_match_fract_max"] = (
2519                    ms2_annot_sub["ref_mz_in_query_fract"]
2520                    == ms2_annot_sub["ref_mz_in_query_fract"].max()
2521                )
2522                ms2_annot_sub["frag_max"] = ms2_annot_sub["query_frag_types"].apply(
2523                    lambda x: True if "MLF" in x else False
2524                )
2525
2526                # New column that looks if there is a consensus between the ranks (one row that is highest in all ranks)
2527                ms2_annot_sub["consensus"] = ms2_annot_sub[
2528                    ["entropy_max", "ref_match_fract_max", "frag_max"]
2529                ].all(axis=1)
2530                ms2_annot_sub_con = ms2_annot_sub[ms2_annot_sub["consensus"]]
2531                id_sub.append(ms2_annot_sub_con)
2532                id_no_con.append(ms2_annot_sub)
2533            id_sub = pd.concat(id_sub)
2534            id_no_con = pd.concat(id_no_con)
2535
2536            # Scenario 1: Multiple scans are being resolved to different MLFs [could be coelutions and should both be kept and annotated to MS level]
2537            if (
2538                id_sub["query_frag_types"]
2539                .apply(lambda x: True if "MLF" in x else False)
2540                .all()
2541                and len(id_sub) > 0
2542            ):
2543                idx = id_sub.groupby("name")["entropy_similarity"].idxmax()
2544                id_sub = id_sub.loc[idx]
2545                # Reorder so highest entropy_similarity is first
2546                id_sub = id_sub.sort_values("entropy_similarity", ascending=False)
2547                id_sub["annot_level"] = id_sub["structure_level"]
2548                no_consensus.append(id_sub)
2549
2550            # Scenario 2: Multiple scans are being resolved to different species, keep both and annotate to appropriate level
2551            elif len(id_sub) == 0:
2552                for lipid_summed_name in id_no_con["lipid_summed_name"].unique():
2553                    summed_sub = id_no_con[
2554                        id_no_con["lipid_summed_name"] == lipid_summed_name

2556                    # Any consensus to MLF?
2557                    if summed_sub["consensus"].any():
2558                        summed_sub = summed_sub[summed_sub["consensus"]]
2559                        summed_sub["annot_level"] = summed_sub["structure_level"]
2560                        no_consensus.append(summed_sub)
2561                    else:
2562                        # Grab the highest entropy_similarity, if there are multiple, grab the first one
2563                        summed_sub = summed_sub[
2564                            summed_sub["entropy_similarity"]
2565                            == summed_sub["entropy_similarity"].max()
2566                        ].head(1)
2567                        # get first row
2568                        summed_sub["annot_level"] = "species"
2569                        summed_sub["name"] = ""
2570                        no_consensus.append(summed_sub)
2571            else:
2572                raise ValueError("Unexpected scenario for summarizing mf_id: ", mf_id)
2573
2574        if len(no_consensus) > 0:
2575            no_consensus = pd.concat(no_consensus)
2576        else:
2577            no_consensus = ms2_annot.head(0)
2578
2579        # Combine all the consensus annotations and reformat the dataframe for output
2580        species_results_all = species_results_all.drop(columns=["name"])
2581        species_results_all["lipid_molecular_species_id"] = ""
2582        mlf_results_all["lipid_molecular_species_id"] = mlf_results_all["name"]
2583        no_consensus["lipid_molecular_species_id"] = no_consensus["name"]
2584        consensus_annotations = pd.concat(

2587        consensus_annotations = consensus_annotations.sort_values(
2588            "mf_id", ascending=True
2589        )
2590        cols_to_keep = [
2591            "mf_id",
2592            "ref_ion_type",
2593            "entropy_similarity",
2594            "ref_mz_in_query_fract",
2595            "lipid_molecular_species_id",
2596            "lipid_summed_name",
2597            "lipid_subclass",
2598            "lipid_class",
2599            "lipid_category",
2600            "formula",
2601            "annot_level",
2602            "n_spectra_contributing",
2603        ]
2604        consensus_annotations = consensus_annotations[cols_to_keep]
2605        consensus_annotations = consensus_annotations.set_index("mf_id")

2607        return consensus_annotations

This constructor should always be called with keyword arguments. Arguments are:

group should be None; reserved for future extension when a ThreadGroup class is implemented.

target is the callable object to be invoked by the run() method. Defaults to None, meaning nothing is called.

name is the thread name. By default, a unique name is constructed of the form "Thread-N" where N is a small decimal number.

args is a list or tuple of arguments for the target invocation. Defaults to ().

kwargs is a dictionary of keyword arguments for the target invocation. Defaults to {}.

If a subclass overrides the constructor, it must make sure to invoke the base class constructor (Thread.__init__()) before doing anything else to the thread.

2364            The MS2 annotation DataFrame with all annotations.
2365
2366        Returns
2367        -------
2368        DataFrame
2369            The summarized lipid report.
2370        """
2371        # Drop unnecessary columns for easier viewing
2372        columns_to_drop = [
2373            "precursor_mz",
2374            "precursor_mz_error_ppm",
2375            "ref_mol_id",
2376            "ref_precursor_mz",
2377            "cas",
2378            "inchikey",
2379            "inchi",
2380            "chebi",
2381            "smiles",
2382            "kegg",
2383            "data_id",
2384            "iupac_name",
2385            "traditional_name",
2386            "common_name",
2387            "casno",
2388        ]
2389        ms2_annot = ms2_annot.drop(
2390            columns=[col for col in columns_to_drop if col in ms2_annot.columns]
2391        )
2392
2393        # If ion_types_excluded is not empty, remove those ion types
2394        ion_types_excluded = self.mass_spectra.parameters.mass_spectrum[
2395            "ms2"
2396        ].molecular_search.ion_types_excluded
2397        if len(ion_types_excluded) > 0:
2398            ms2_annot = ms2_annot[~ms2_annot["ref_ion_type"].isin(ion_types_excluded)]
2399
2400        # If mf_id is not present, check that the index name is mf_id and reset the index
2401        if "mf_id" not in ms2_annot.columns:
2402            if ms2_annot.index.name == "mf_id":
2403                ms2_annot = ms2_annot.reset_index()
2404            else:
2405                raise ValueError("mf_id is not present in the dataframe")
2406
2407        # Attempt to get consensus annotations to the MLF level
2408        mlf_results_all = []
2409        for mf_id in ms2_annot["mf_id"].unique():
2410            mlf_results_perid = []
2411            ms2_annot_mf = ms2_annot[ms2_annot["mf_id"] == mf_id].copy()
2412            ms2_annot_mf["n_spectra_contributing"] = (
2413                ms2_annot_mf.query_spectrum_id.nunique()
2414            )
2415
2416            for query_scan in ms2_annot["query_spectrum_id"].unique():
2417                ms2_annot_sub = ms2_annot_mf[
2418                    ms2_annot_mf["query_spectrum_id"] == query_scan
2419                ].copy()
2420
2421                if ms2_annot_sub["lipid_summed_name"].nunique() == 1:
2422                    # If there is only one lipid_summed_name, let's try to get consensus molecular species annotation
2423                    if ms2_annot_sub["lipid_summed_name"].nunique() == 1:
2424                        ms2_annot_sub["entropy_max"] = (
2425                            ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"]
2426                            == ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"].max()
2427                        )
2428                        ms2_annot_sub["ref_match_fract_max"] = (
2429                            ms2_annot_sub["ref_mz_in_query_fract"]
2430                            == ms2_annot_sub["ref_mz_in_query_fract"].max()
2431                        )
2432                        ms2_annot_sub["frag_max"] = ms2_annot_sub[
2433                            "query_frag_types"
2434                        ].apply(lambda x: True if "MLF" in x else False)
2435
2436                        # New column that looks if there is a consensus between the ranks (one row that is highest in all ranks)
2437                        ms2_annot_sub["consensus"] = ms2_annot_sub[
2438                            ["entropy_max", "ref_match_fract_max", "frag_max"]
2439                        ].all(axis=1)
2440
2441                        # If there is a consensus, take the row with the highest entropy_similarity
2442                        if ms2_annot_sub["consensus"].any():
2443                            ms2_annot_sub = ms2_annot_sub[
2444                                ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"]
2445                                == ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"].max()
2446                            ].head(1)
2447                            mlf_results_perid.append(ms2_annot_sub)
2448            if len(mlf_results_perid) == 0:
2449                mlf_results_perid = pd.DataFrame()
2450            else:
2451                mlf_results_perid = pd.concat(mlf_results_perid)
2452                if mlf_results_perid["name"].nunique() == 1:
2453                    mlf_results_perid = mlf_results_perid[
2454                        mlf_results_perid["entropy_similarity"]
2455                        == mlf_results_perid["entropy_similarity"].max()
2456                    ].head(1)
2457                else:
2458                    mlf_results_perid = pd.DataFrame()
2459                mlf_results_all.append(mlf_results_perid)
2460
2461        # These are the consensus annotations to the MLF level
2462        if len(mlf_results_all) > 0:
2463            mlf_results_all = pd.concat(mlf_results_all)
2464            mlf_results_all["annot_level"] = mlf_results_all["structure_level"]
2465        else:
2466            # Make an empty dataframe
2467            mlf_results_all = ms2_annot.head(0)
2468
2469        # For remaining mf_ids, try to get a consensus annotation to the species level
2470        species_results_all = []
2471        # Remove mf_ids that have consensus annotations to the MLF level
2472        ms2_annot_spec = ms2_annot[
2473            ~ms2_annot["mf_id"].isin(mlf_results_all["mf_id"].unique())
2474        ]
2475        for mf_id in ms2_annot_spec["mf_id"].unique():
2476            # Do all the hits have the same lipid_summed_name?
2477            ms2_annot_sub = ms2_annot_spec[ms2_annot_spec["mf_id"] == mf_id].copy()
2478            ms2_annot_sub["n_spectra_contributing"] = len(ms2_annot_sub)
2479
2480            if ms2_annot_sub["lipid_summed_name"].nunique() == 1:
2481                # Grab the highest entropy_similarity result
2482                ms2_annot_sub = ms2_annot_sub[
2483                    ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"]
2484                    == ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"].max()
2485                ].head(1)
2486                species_results_all.append(ms2_annot_sub)
2487
2488        # These are the consensus annotations to the species level
2489        if len(species_results_all) > 0:
2490            species_results_all = pd.concat(species_results_all)
2491            species_results_all["annot_level"] = "species"
2492        else:
2493            # Make an empty dataframe
2494            species_results_all = ms2_annot.head(0)
2495
2496        # Deal with the remaining mf_ids that do not have consensus annotations to the species level or MLF level
2497        # Remove mf_ids that have consensus annotations to the species level
2498        ms2_annot_remaining = ms2_annot_spec[
2499            ~ms2_annot_spec["mf_id"].isin(species_results_all["mf_id"].unique())
2500        ]
2501        no_consensus = []
2502        for mf_id in ms2_annot_remaining["mf_id"].unique():
2503            id_sub = []
2504            id_no_con = []
2505            ms2_annot_sub_mf = ms2_annot_remaining[
2506                ms2_annot_remaining["mf_id"] == mf_id
2507            ].copy()
2508            for query_scan in ms2_annot_sub_mf["query_spectrum_id"].unique():
2509                ms2_annot_sub = ms2_annot_sub_mf[
2510                    ms2_annot_sub_mf["query_spectrum_id"] == query_scan
2511                ].copy()
2512
2513                # New columns for ranking [HIGHER RANK = BETTER]
2514                ms2_annot_sub["entropy_max"] = (
2515                    ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"]
2516                    == ms2_annot_sub["entropy_similarity"].max()
2517                )
2518                ms2_annot_sub["ref_match_fract_max"] = (
2519                    ms2_annot_sub["ref_mz_in_query_fract"]
2520                    == ms2_annot_sub["ref_mz_in_query_fract"].max()
2521                )
2522                ms2_annot_sub["frag_max"] = ms2_annot_sub["query_frag_types"].apply(
2523                    lambda x: True if "MLF" in x else False
2524                )
2525
2526                # New column that looks if there is a consensus between the ranks (one row that is highest in all ranks)
2527                ms2_annot_sub["consensus"] = ms2_annot_sub[
2528                    ["entropy_max", "ref_match_fract_max", "frag_max"]
2529                ].all(axis=1)
2530                ms2_annot_sub_con = ms2_annot_sub[ms2_annot_sub["consensus"]]
2531                id_sub.append(ms2_annot_sub_con)
2532                id_no_con.append(ms2_annot_sub)
2533            id_sub = pd.concat(id_sub)
2534            id_no_con = pd.concat(id_no_con)
2535
2536            # Scenario 1: Multiple scans are being resolved to different MLFs [could be coelutions and should both be kept and annotated to MS level]
2537            if (
2538                id_sub["query_frag_types"]
2539                .apply(lambda x: True if "MLF" in x else False)
2540                .all()
2541                and len(id_sub) > 0
2542            ):
2543                idx = id_sub.groupby("name")["entropy_similarity"].idxmax()
2544                id_sub = id_sub.loc[idx]
2545                # Reorder so highest entropy_similarity is first
2546                id_sub = id_sub.sort_values("entropy_similarity", ascending=False)
2547                id_sub["annot_level"] = id_sub["structure_level"]
2548                no_consensus.append(id_sub)
2549
2550            # Scenario 2: Multiple scans are being resolved to different species, keep both and annotate to appropriate level
2551            elif len(id_sub) == 0:
2552                for lipid_summed_name in id_no_con["lipid_summed_name"].unique():
2553                    summed_sub = id_no_con[
2554                        id_no_con["lipid_summed_name"] == lipid_summed_name
2555                    ]
2556                    # Any consensus to MLF?
2557                    if summed_sub["consensus"].any():
2558                        summed_sub = summed_sub[summed_sub["consensus"]]
2559                        summed_sub["annot_level"] = summed_sub["structure_level"]
2560                        no_consensus.append(summed_sub)
2561                    else:
2562                        # Grab the highest entropy_similarity, if there are multiple, grab the first one
2563                        summed_sub = summed_sub[
2564                            summed_sub["entropy_similarity"]
2565                            == summed_sub["entropy_similarity"].max()
2566                        ].head(1)
2567                        # get first row
2568                        summed_sub["annot_level"] = "species"
2569                        summed_sub["name"] = ""
2570                        no_consensus.append(summed_sub)
2571            else:
2572                raise ValueError("Unexpected scenario for summarizing mf_id: ", mf_id)
2573
2574        if len(no_consensus) > 0:
2575            no_consensus = pd.concat(no_consensus)
2576        else:
2577            no_consensus = ms2_annot.head(0)
2578
2579        # Combine all the consensus annotations and reformat the dataframe for output
2580        species_results_all = species_results_all.drop(columns=["name"])
2581        species_results_all["lipid_molecular_species_id"] = ""
2582        mlf_results_all["lipid_molecular_species_id"] = mlf_results_all["name"]
2583        no_consensus["lipid_molecular_species_id"] = no_consensus["name"]
2584        consensus_annotations = pd.concat(
2585            [mlf_results_all, species_results_all, no_consensus]
2586        )
2587        consensus_annotations = consensus_annotations.sort_values(
2588            "mf_id", ascending=True
2589        )
2590        cols_to_keep = [
2591            "mf_id",
2592            "ref_ion_type",
2593            "entropy_similarity",
2594            "ref_mz_in_query_fract",
2595            "lipid_molecular_species_id",
2596            "lipid_summed_name",
2597            "lipid_subclass",
2598            "lipid_class",
2599            "lipid_category",
2600            "formula",
2601            "annot_level",
2602            "n_spectra_contributing",
2603        ]
2604        consensus_annotations = consensus_annotations[cols_to_keep]
2605        consensus_annotations = consensus_annotations.set_index("mf_id")
2606
2607        return consensus_annotations

2655        """Create a report of the mass features and their annotations.

2671        # Get mass feature dataframe

2673        mf_report = mf_report.reset_index(drop=False)
2674
2675        # Get and clean ms1 annotation dataframe

2677        ms1_annot_report = self.clean_ms1_report(ms1_annot_report)
2678        ms1_annot_report = ms1_annot_report.reset_index(drop=False)
2679
2680        # Get, summarize, and clean ms2 annotation dataframe
2681        ms2_annot_report = self.mass_spectra.mass_features_ms2_annot_to_df(
2682            molecular_metadata=molecular_metadata
2683        )
2684        if ms2_annot_report is not None and molecular_metadata is not None:
2685            ms2_annot_report = self.summarize_lipid_report(ms2_annot_report)
2686            ms2_annot_report = self.clean_ms2_report(ms2_annot_report)
2687            ms2_annot_report = ms2_annot_report.dropna(axis=1, how="all")
2688            ms2_annot_report = ms2_annot_report.reset_index(drop=False)
2689        report = self.combine_reports(
2690            mf_report=mf_report,
2691            ms1_annot_report=ms1_annot_report,
2692            ms2_annot_report=ms2_annot_report,
2693        )
2694        return report
